text: Sparco is majority-owned by the Italian entrepreneur Aldino Bellazzini, its executive president since 2009; he acquired the company in 2009 and his two children hold board and management roles.
short: Aldino Bellazzini is Sparco's majority shareholder and executive president.

source.name: Il Dossier: "Aldino Bellazzini: da 16 anni al timone di Sparco, una vera eccellenza tutta italiana"
source.quote: da sedici anni è azionista di maggioranza, presidente esecutivo di Sparco
source.note: Italian: 'for sixteen years [Aldino Bellazzini has been] majority shareholder, executive president of Sparco'. The interview also covers his 2009 acquisition and his children Ida (board) and Niccolò (brand manager).
